grants.description: Verify your business identity using Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) or Company Number
grants.purpose: To confirm the legal identity of the business registering for VAT

grants.description: Share business turnover and financial information with HMRC
grants.purpose: To determine mandatory or voluntary VAT registration eligibility and appropriate VAT scheme

grants.description: Provide business bank account for VAT refunds and direct debit payments
grants.purpose: To process VAT refunds and set up direct debit for VAT payments

grants.description: Allow HMRC to verify turnover and business records if required
grants.purpose: To verify VAT registration eligibility and compliance with VAT obligations

grants.description: Provide details of business representative or accountant (if applicable)
grants.purpose: To allow authorised representatives to manage VAT on behalf of the business

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC VAT helpline, revoke through HMRC online account, or submit VAT7 form to deregister
revocation.effect: Registration application will be cancelled if consent revoked before completion. After registration, deregistration process must be followed separately.

delegation.agent_identity: GOV.UK AI Agent acting on behalf of business owner/director
delegation.limitations: Agent cannot select VAT accounting scheme without explicit business owner approval. Agent cannot provide or change bank account details without explicit confirmation from account holder. Agent cannot authorise tax representatives without business owner approval. Complex cases (VAT groups, overseas businesses, late registration) must be handed off to human HMRC advisor.
